title: Mixed-tier bundle min-cost pricing untested: no pin draws parallel different-tier pipes and asserts the edge cost/ECMP condition
detail: P0 critical path with NONE coverage: no test draws parallel different-tier pipes and asserts the edge prices at the fattest member or that the ECMP condition uses that cost. Four contracts cover mixed-tier paths only.
recommended_fix: Add a pin: parallel narrow+wide pipes between one pair, assert the bundle edge prices at min member (5) and the ECMP set/next-hop reflects it; assert representative pipe stays lowest-slot.

title: Frozen spec item 2 prices bundle edge at 'representative pipe's tier cost'; code/decision-log/arch price at min (fattest) member
detail: Doc-accuracy: for a narrow-then-wide bundle, spec item 2 prices the edge at the lowest-slot pipe (20); code, decision-log, and arch §6.2 price at min member (5). Spec's own review order says 'min-cost bundles'.
recommended_fix: Reword spec item 2: 'edge cost = MINIMUM member tier cost (the fattest member); the representative pipe stays the lowest-slot member (matches Hop.pipe)'.

title: i32 dist-overflow guard for pathological cost ladders deferred and untested (documented)
evidence:
summary: Add an upper-bound validation for pipe_tiers cost (e.g. <= 1e6) to make dist-accumulation overflow impossible in routing_rebuild.
  evidence: catalog validation only enforces cost >= 1 (the ruling's per-hop progress guarantee); a pathological huge ladder value could overflow the i32 dist sums in the Dijkstra. The shipped ladder 20/10/5 is safe; magnitude caps on balance data are a pre-existing pattern (capacity_units etc. are unbounded too) — ride with the playtest/balance gate, not this canon job.
detail: Deferred P0-list guard, NONE coverage by design: 'a pathological huge ladder value could overflow the i32 dist sums in the Dijkstra.' Note-level per lens guards — ride with the playtest/balance gate.
recommended_fix: When the balance gate lands, add a cost upper-bound in catalog validation with a reject row plus a large-cost routing test.
